turns.q: If they want to exchange it, how would that work?
turns.replyText:
Customer CareAgent said: Here’s how exchanges work for gifts from Faherty: **Gift Exchange Process** - The recipient can exchange or return the item for store credit within 60 days of purchase. - To start, they’ll need the seven-digit order PO# (from the packing slip) and the shipping ZIP code. - They can initiate the process online at the [Returns Center](https://fahertybrand.loopreturns.com/#/) by selecting “Received a gift? turns.q: Any discount if I add a second smaller item?
turns.replyText:
Customer CareAgent said: Yes, Faherty offers bundle discounts on select items! For example: - You can save 20% when you add two or more Sunwashed Tees or Movement Shirts to your cart (online only). - This discount applies automatically at checkout for eligible items. If you’d like to add a second smaller item, let me know which one you’re interested in (or if you want to see tee options), and I’ll help you with the total and next steps.
